text: helper function get_network_info can used get information readily: returns named vector: nodes: number nodes. edges: number edges. ASPL: Average shortest path length refers mean shortest path possible node pairs (non-infinite path). global CC: Global clustering coefficient transitivity refers proportion closed triangles network relative number possible triangles. measure overall level local connectivity among nodes network. mean CC: average local clustering coefficient refers mean node’s local clustering coefficient, measures amount interconnectivity local neighborhood node. diameter: Diameter refers length longest short path node pairs network. mean degree: average degree nodes network. Degree refers number links (neighbors) node . . components: number distinct, separate components network. prop. LCC: proportion nodes found largest connected component network. details measures application language cognitive networks, please refer https://csqsiew.github.io (online tutorial “Introduction Network Analysis igraph”) Siew et al. (2019). wish compute network measures, can simply pass network object relevant igraph function. compute density network g1:
